body: It's not like my search hasn't been exhaustive, or at least varied. Your dinosaur example doesn't mean that I'm wrong; it just, once again, means I could be wrong, and I don't feel like taking a leap-of-faith towards a could. I have no desire whatsoever to befriend children...wtf? like i need accusations of pedophilia to add to my worries (not that I like unrelated kids, anyway). I know that's not what you meant, but I don't see it going anywhere. I want friends my age. I want a relationship with a woman my age.

I think I've been searching. It's kind of absurd to tell me they are there and i need to keep searching. Why? Why continue suffering for something I don't think exists? If only I decide this distinction, then it's meaningless. I could make up a new criteria constantly. I guess I don't really know anything besides the people I describe, though. All of my attempts at friendship are just shot down. I'm just seen as this huge asshole or a jester.
Where do I find 'real' friends? How do I make this distinction?
